devdoc.details: The inherited intent reads decode through IOrchestratorV2 and revert on OrchestratorV4 intents. The V4 reads accept only orchestrators that report the IOrchestratorV4 interface, so a caller that routes the wrong way fails with InvalidOrchestrator instead of a decoding error.
devdoc.title: ProtocolViewerV4

userdoc.notice: ProtocolViewerV2 plus intent reads for OrchestratorV4.
